title: Hidden Blade
description: [BEING REWORKED] Adds a (not really) Hidden blade item with Mcreator restrictions
body:
Mod icon made by: https://ewanhowell.com/plugins/minecraft-title-generator/ 

Adds in a Hidden blade item that you can use, Since Mcreator is really restrictive with mod making I couldent make it an equipable item so its a physical item like a sword. Idea for the mod was based off of [Assasin's Creed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Assassin%27s_Creed) and the model colors is based off of the one seen on ~~the Assasin's Arsenal mod for B&s~~, I was wrong about that mb anways at the current moment you cannot stealth kill anyone or deal any extra damage, unless someone can made a mod like that with mcreator and makes it open sorce then i can't add that.

R toggles it by default and can be changed in the gameplay section of the controls page

Known bugs:
Enchantments don't stay when you toggle the blade
Health doesn't change when you toggle the blade (even though the code should work perfectly)
